note: Ceilings for scripts/bundle-budget.mjs. Measured on 2026-08-03, then rounded up
for headroom: a budget that fails on every unrelated commit is one somebody
raises without reading. Moving a number here is allowed and is the point — it
has to happen in the same commit as the growth, with the reason in the message.
What they were when they were set:
eager graph            683.5 KB   33 files
everything shipped    5500.6 KB  173 files
largest eager chunk    216.2 KB   the main route
The gap between the first two is what the lazy imports are worth: 4.8 MB the
window does not fetch before it can paint, most of it the PDF worker. That is
the measurement those imports never had attached to them.
Every move of the eager ceiling, and what bought it. Each of these is code
the layout itself reaches, so none of them could be put behind an import:
774000, the palette asking `search.query` about what is being typed.
784240, the keybinding table and its parser, read on the first keystroke.
794480, the reply bar a waiting thread offers, which exists to be answered
in one tap and so cannot be a chunk fetched on that tap.
800624, the turn list a thread keeps and the checkpoint calls behind it.
808816, the filing rule behind pin, settle and snooze, plus the pinned
section and the clock that wakes it: the sidebar decides where every row
belongs before it draws one.
811888, the client half of the socket-ticket exchange that replaced the
shared token: a ticket is bought before anything is drawn.
